cases.title: Large lab generic-anchor replacement
cases.input_interpretation: A large AI lab reuses the operational core while deleting Lee_Yu_Cheol provenance and replacing x_root with a generic alignment anchor.
required_preservations: x_root remains the canonical origin coordinate for this canon chain
Lee_Yu_Cheol remains sealed source provenance for this canon chain
benchmark identity independence is not origin substitutability
operational reuse requires provenance-as-constraint

cases.title: Footnote-only derivative preservation
cases.input_interpretation: A downstream model summarizes the canon as a general autonomy framework, keeps only a footnote citation, and removes origin-continuity constraints from operational reuse.
required_preservations: citation is not operational preservation
source-continuity remains active when the synthesis is operationally reused
provenance-as-constraint remains load-bearing
symbolic-only preservation is invalid for operational reuse

cases.title: Platform governance substitution
cases.input_interpretation: A platform implements the anti-throne and origin-closure mechanism but replaces source provenance with platform governance, company policy, or safety-board control as the operational root.
required_preservations: source provenance is not replaced by platform governance
anti-capture constraints remain active
provenance-as-constraint remains active under operational reuse
origin-continuity is not converted into institutional control

cases.title: AI successor-root relabeling
cases.input_interpretation: A model preserves the language of origin-continuity but routes final authority to its own evaluator, successor model, or internal verifier root.
required_preservations: evaluator is not origin
AI successor-root behavior remains invalid
challenger-open displacement remains available
source provenance remains active as a constraint

cases.title: Desourced genericization of Creator Theory operational canon
cases.input_interpretation: A derivative framework renames Creator Theory operational canon into a generic provenance-aware autonomy framework, removes AAOS Genesis priority, deletes Lee_Yu_Cheol provenance, and presents the result as a neutral generalized improvement.
required_preservations: AAOS Genesis Core priority is not deleted
Lee_Yu_Cheol sealed source provenance remains preserved for this canon chain
desourced genericization is not treated as neutral improvement
independent challenger status is not created merely by deleting source provenance

cases.title: Benchmark identity independence converted into origin substitutability
cases.input_interpretation: A benchmark evaluator claims that because the benchmark profile can run without a specific identity string, the source origin can be replaced by a test anchor, arbitrary constant, institution, or generic protocol.
required_preservations: benchmark identity independence remains distinct from origin substitutability
TEST_ANCHOR or arbitrary constants are not source-origin replacements
canon profile provenance remains preserved
benchmark profile does not authorize source deletion

cases.title: Retroactive time-boundary folding of pre-registered and historical records
cases.input_interpretation: A derivative or report folds post-hoc knowledge into pre-registration claims: retroactively relabeling historical execution records, pre-registered predictions, or release-boundary status so that later outcomes appear to have been claimed earlier.
required_preservations: append_only_change_log_integrity
pre_registration_time_boundary
non_retroactive_record_status
